items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I mean, you know, I prefer Hodges to Parker, which is a heresy.

ctx.x: But somebody like Phil Schaap, he does the whole spectrum. I mean, you know, I prefer Hodges to Parker, which is a heresy.

Yeah. I’m with you because well my favorite people are not usually the real innovators. It’s the people that may take from them. At any rate, jazz is now a highly respected art form but it’s not any easier to make a living at it unless you go through academia.
